name: Shishito Pepper
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as peppers are generally easy to digest and low in fermentable carbohydrates.
preparationTips: Blistering in a hot pan enhances flavor and makes them easier to digest
Remove seeds if you have sensitive digestion
Cook until skin is charred and peppers are tender
Season with sea salt and a drizzle of garlic-infused oil
